title: b7z9.5.2a: Node Stack gains a bounded FragmentationPolicy field (RX seam plumbing, no receive wiring)
description: Smallest landable child of b7z9.5.2 (R-05-065 RX reassembly). Add a FragmentationPolicy<MAX_PEERS> field to rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs Stack (const generic, e.g. 8), constructed in Stack::new (FragmentationPolicy::new() may fail — decide construction-time panic vs Result; match Stack::new's existing assert style), plus a pub(crate)/pub accessor for the RX wiring slice and expire_due integration. NO receive() wiring in this slice, no peer-context authority (that is .2b), no tests beyond construction/green suite. Scout note from 2026-08-31: Stack currently has NO PeerContextAuthority/AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext plumbing (decompress_authenticated_frame uses the failure-tracker path only), so the receiver cannot be constructed from Stack state today — hence this seam-first decomposition; permits are minted by the policy itself (fragment.rs:371/400) at admission time.
close_reason: Landed as feat(node) commit on beads-worker-4. Stack gains pub(crate) FragmentationPolicy<8> field, constructed in Stack::new via expect (matches adjacent RuleVersionFailureTracker house style; only failure mode reachable at const 8 is the process-lifetime global owner-counter exhaustion, unreachable within plausible uptime — security pass confirmed not attacker-reachable), plus a pub(crate) accessor and a pub use fragment::FragmentationPolicy re-export in lichen-schc lib.rs (type is no_std-safe; cargo check -p lichen-node --no-default-features passes). No receive() wiring in this slice by design (peer-context authority absent from Stack — that plumbing is b7z9.5.2.2, filed with scout notes). Smoke test pins the seam: fragmentation_policy_seam_is_constructed_and_expired asserts expire_due(0)==Ok(0) on the empty policy. Gates: cargo test -p lichen-node --lib 303/303; clippy -p lichen-node --all-features -D warnings and clippy -p lichen-schc --all-features -D warnings clean. Codereview 3x: pass 1 correctness DELEGATED (kimi-k3) — construction-failure analysis PASS, re-export no_std/std PASS, one finding on expect/gate interaction; pass 2 security DELEGATED = PASS (capability surface narrow — mutators take &mut self and are unreachable via the & accessor; Stack becomes !Sync via RefCell, compile-loud if ever needed; DoS on PolicyFull not reachable); pass 3 edge delegated but timed out (590s) — self-completed per fallback rule (no_std check, expire_due t=0 semantics pinned by test, capacity choice documented in field doc). Findings addressed in-slice: reviewer-flagged duplicate doc block on new_default_epoch and comment-glued-to-brace in the elided test (my edit slips, fixed); dead-code expectation hardened to #[cfg_attr(not(test), expect(...))] so BOTH plain and --all-targets clippy gates pass (pre-existing --all-targets-only lint in routing/tests.rs:2326 redundant-closure noted, not mine, not fixed per surgical-changes rule).
